# Girl on a Zebra

> > A travel blog featuring destination guides, itineraries, and practical tips for exploring Europe, Central America, and beyond.

Girl on a Zebra provides comprehensive travel guides with a focus on France (Paris, Provence, French Riviera, Bordeaux), Costa Rica (Monteverde, Arenal Volcano, beach destinations), and emerging European destinations like Albania. The site covers accommodation recommendations, road trip itineraries, and resources for digital nomads and wildlife tourism enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- France travel guides
- Paris and Seine River
- Provence and French Riviera
- Bordeaux wine region
- Costa Rica adventures
- Monteverde and Arenal Volcano
- Beach destinations
- Albanian Riviera
- Europe itineraries
- Road trip planning
- Digital nomad resources
- Wildlife tourism
- Christmas markets
- Accommodation guides
- Caribbean coast travel
